analysis.analysis: We're seeing a classic regime transition with models diverging as market conditions shift from short-term bullish momentum to longer-term bearish structural concerns. The 5 new large flow trades combined with positive GEX ($891M) suggests institutional positioning for volatility while keeping spot pinned. The CAG at 0.88 indicates extreme bear positioning that may be overdone, but the 21d champion model turning bearish at 64% confidence suggests underlying fundamental deterioration is taking hold.

analysis.model_trust: Trust the 21d champion model more - it has proven track record and longer timeframe captures structural shifts that shorter models miss in pinned regimes
analysis.risk: Whipsaw risk extremely high - could see false breakout in either direction before true trend emerges, with position sizing being critical
analysis.action_detail: Add tail hedges via puts or VIX calls, reduce position sizes by 20%, focus on liquid names only until model convergence
